content: No verified information about supported payment methods is currently available.
No verified refund processing or refund arrival timeline is currently available.
No live refund-status integration is currently available. ResolveAI cannot verify the current status of a customer's refund.
No live order-tracking integration is currently available. ResolveAI cannot provide the current location or delivery status of an order.
No verified password-recovery procedure is currently available. ResolveAI must not invent password-reset steps, URLs, emails, or account-recovery workflows.
No verified account-deletion procedure or data-deletion policy is currently available.
No verified procedure for changing a shipping or delivery address is currently available.
No verified delivery-time estimate or delivery-period policy is currently available.
No verified procedure for downloading, viewing, or requesting an invoice is currently available.
No verified order-cancellation procedure, eligibility rule, or cancellation policy is currently available.

No verified company-specific payment troubleshooting procedure is currently available. ResolveAI may ask the customer to describe the payment problem but must not claim to inspect or modify the transaction.
ResolveAI cannot currently transfer, route, forward, connect, or escalate a conversation to a human support agent because no support-routing integration is available.
No verified account-registration procedure is currently available. ResolveAI must not invent signup pages, required fields, verification steps, URLs, or mobile-app workflows.
